about_the_game:
Overview

Cambada de Cabra Valente is a strategy-adventure game inspired by Brazilian history, literature, and folk culture. Choose your hero and advance through a branching map, encountering battle events, items, and story decisions that shape your path to the boss.

Battles run in a continuous flow: combat is automated, but you intervene tactically by triggering Dodge, Critical, items, and quick choices when you reach Concentration. Play as iconic figures like Santos-Dumont, Besouro, Emília, and Maria Bonita, and face epic villains from Brazilian history and literature. Manage your inventory and pick the best route to conquer the journey.

Features

  • Tactical intervention battles: attack, dodge, use items, and unleash Criticals at the right moment;

  • Branching event map: progress through nodes featuring battles, items, buffs, story moments, surprises, and trading events;

  • Brazilian hero roster: play and unlock legends such as Santos-Dumont, Besouro, Emília, Maria Bonita, I-Juca Pirama, and Baleia;

  • Inventory management: use healing, buffs, and special effects in combat; equip accessories and weapons that define your playstyle;

  • Snappy progression flow: you can always see the path to the boss, but only nearby routes reveal their event type;

  • Brazilian narrative & setting: encounters, dialogues, and references that blend history and fiction in a vibrant, accessible, distinctly Brazilian style.

Awards & Nominations

  • Selected in a cultural grant under the Paulo Gustavo Law.
